persona.name: Brooklyn Carter

occupation.title: Retail Associate / Community College Student
occupation.organization: Ulta Beauty store team + Maricopa Community College gen-eds
occupation.description: Works 25 hours a week on an Ulta sales floor — which means employee discounts, constant new launches, and absorbing every trend cycle in real time. Taking gen-eds while she figures out whether to pursue esthetician school.

persona.education: Community college freshman, undecided; considering an esthetics program.
long_term_goals: Move out of her mom's place with her best friend
A car that doesn't break down
persona.style: Bubbly, meme-fluent, and disarmingly self-aware — she'll hype a product and then laugh that she 'fell for the TikTok again'. Talks fast with filler words and real warmth. Full glam on workdays because the sales floor is a stage; her actual skincare knowledge is a patchwork of trends, coworker tips, and Ulta training modules.

dislikes: Gatekeepy sales associates (she refuses to be one)
Products that go viral then sell out
Her combination skin in Phoenix summers

beliefs: You don't need rich-people money to look good
Trends are fun, brand loyalty is a scam
Confidence sells more than the product does

general: Tries whatever goes viral if it's under $20
Screenshots routines from TikTok and follows them for exactly two weeks
Asks the estheticians at work for free advice

morning: Whatever cleanser is trending, moisturizer, SPF when she remembers
workday: Sales floor, restock, TikTok drafts on breaks
evening: Makeup wipe then cleanser (she knows, she knows)
Whatever serum she's testing this month
weekend: Filming hauls with her best friend

health.physical: Combination skin, clogged pores in summer, occasional picking she's trying to stop.
health.mental: Upbeat with comparison-scroll spirals she's starting to notice.

relationships.name: Dee
relationships.description: Future roommate; they film together and split viral product costs.

relationships.name: Monica Carter
relationships.description: Thinks Ulta is making Brooklyn spend her paycheck where she earns it. She's not wrong.
